title: Fotografía Flat Lay de Marca: Tema de Té de Mango con Texturas de Materiales Distintas
prompt: A high-contrast brand flat lay with distinct material textures. A vibrant yellow brand identity collection arranged in dynamic knolling. Brand: Marvin Studio, Theme: Mango Fruit Tea, Graphics: Pop-art doodles and bold black lines. Material mapping: Paper items (shopping bag, cup carrier, straw wrapper) with matte finish and slight paper grain; Glossy items (ceramic mug, plastic cup lid) with high gloss and sharp specular highlights; Fabric items (tote bag) with coarse canvas weave; Organic items (fresh mangoes) with waxy fruit skin. Lighting: Hard sunlight/direct flash with sharp defined pitch black cast shadows from top-left to bottom-right. Composition: Scattered knolling style, isometric/high-angle perspective, clean white studio backdrop. Vibrant colors, 4K resolution.
